# Friendr

You want to do something fun with your friends, so you send a message. And another one. And another one. 40 messages later, who's actually coming?

There's a much easier way. With Friendr.

Create an event in 20 seconds. Share one link. In the group chat, on Signal, or by email. And your friends sign up with a single tap. No app. No account.

Set a minimum. Not enough interest? Then it's automatically called off. Enough people? Green light for everyone.

Drinks, movie night, werewolves or padel. Everything that's better together.

Friendr. Create an event. Share one link. Done. Try it for free at friendr.nl
